docs.title: Data & Scripts
docs.text: This section provides an overview of the datasets and scripts used in this tutorial. All resources are Nigeria-specific and support hands-on geospatial analysis.

docs.title: Datasets
docs.text:
• Nigeria Administrative Boundaries:
  • Download from GADM or HDX
  • Place in the data/ folder as gadm41_NGA_shp.zip (extract to use the .shp file)
  • Population Data:
  • Download from WorldPop Nigeria
  • Save as data/nga_ppp_2020.tif
  • Health Facility Locations:
  • Download from Nigeria HFR or HDX Health Facilities
  • Save as data/health_facilities.csv
  • Disease Incidence Data:
  • Download from NCDC or WHO
  • Save as data/measles_cases.csv

docs.title: Scripts
docs.text:
• scripts/download_datasets.py: Python script to automate downloading of public datasets. Run with:
python scripts/download_datasets.py

docs.title: Example: Download Script
docs.text:
import os
import requests

def download_file(url, dest):
    if os.path.exists(dest):
        print(f"Already downloaded: {dest}")
        return
    print(f"Downloading {url} ...")
    r = requests.get(url, stream=True)
    r.raise_for_status()
    with open(dest, 'wb') as f:
        for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):
            f.write(chunk)
    print(f"Saved to {dest}")

# Example usage:
download_file('https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/gadm/gadm4.1/shp/gadm41_NGA_shp.zip', 'data/gadm41_NGA_shp.zip')

For more details, see the README or explore the scripts and data folders directly.
